# LokTube 1.5.2

- Fix a Windows main-process crash when closing a LokTube window: the closed-window callback no longer accesses an already-destroyed BrowserWindow.
- Fix browser-to-LokTube YouTube deep links opening the app without opening the requested video: the renderer now explicitly collects queued routes when its tab manager is ready, both on cold starts and when LokTube is already open. The main process no longer invalidates its renderer connection on unrelated subframe loading events.
- Add minimal, privacy-preserving diagnostic events for link receipt and renderer collection to make future handoff failures identifiable without logging full video URLs.
- Add desktop regression coverage for opening an external YouTube link in a new tab while keeping existing tabs intact.

No changes to account authentication or YouTube recommendations.
